title: Counter
source_docs: DSP System Toolbox/Signal Management/Switches and Counters/Counter.md
text: Count up or down through specified range of numbers, 3 inputs, 2 outputs, no direct feedthrough, {Hit values} sets Count values to flag; {Count direction} sets the count up, {Count event} sets the type of trigger event, {Counter size} sets the range of integer values to count through, {Maximum count} sets the maximum value of counter, {Initial count} sets the initial value of counter, {Output}, {Reset input} enables Rst input port, {Samples per output frame} sets the number of samples in each output vector, {Sample time}, {Count data type} sets the data type of Cnt and {Hit data type} sets the data type of Hit. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Inc/Dec
ports.summary: Input signal to trigger count event scalar | vector

ports.name: Cnt
ports.summary: Current value of counter scalar | vector

params.name: Count direction
params.values: Count up or down Up (default) | Down

params.name: Count event
params.values: Type of trigger event Rising edge (default) | Falling edge | Either edge | Non-zero sample | Free running

params.name: Counter size
params.values: Range of integer values to count through 8 bits (default) | 16 bits | 32 bits | User defined | Specify via input port

params.name: Maximum count
params.values: Maximum value of counter 255 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Output
params.values: Output count value, hit value, or both Count (default) | Hit | Count and Hit

params.name: Hit values
params.values: Count values to flag 32 (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: Reset input
params.values: Enable Rst input port on (default) | off

params.name: Samples per output frame
params.values: Number of samples in each output vector 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Sample time in Free Running mode 1 (default) | -1 | scalar ≥ 0

params.name: Count data type
params.values: Data type of Cnt port double (default) | single | int8 | uint8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | uint32

params.name: Hit data type
params.values: Data type of Hit port Logical (default) | Boolean
